name: ai.arcangel/trademark-search
title: Arcangel Trademark Search
description: Check if a brand name is free as a US trademark, then start the application in chat.

tools.name: check_trademark
tools.description: Check whether a brand, product or company name is available as a trademark. Searches the USPTO register and scores similar marks by conflict risk. Free, no account needed. Signed-in Arcangel users can set full_report for a full clearance search (US + EU/WIPO, dead marks, domains, common-law). Results include a link to file the trademark with Arcangel AI.

mark.description: The word mark to check, e.g. "Lumora".

goods_services.description: What the mark will be used for, e.g. "organic skincare". Improves class matching.

classes.description: Nice classes (1-45). Use suggest_nice_classes if unsure.

full_report.description: Full clearance report. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

tools.name: get_trademark_check
tools.description: Get the result of a trademark check that was still running, or the next part of a long full report. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned, and part when the report says it continues.

part.description: Which part of a long full report to return. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: suggest_nice_classes
tools.description: Suggest trademark (Nice) classes for a description of goods or services, e.g. "mobile app for booking yoga classes".

tools.name: start_trademark_application
tools.description: Start a US trademark application on Arcangel AI as a draft in the signed-in user's account. Pass what is known (the mark, goods or services, classes, owner); the rest can be added later with update_trademark_application. If a company owns the mark, pass the id of a saved company (list_companies) as company_id. Returns the draft id and what it still needs. Requires Sign in with Arcangel. Signing and payment happen on arcangel.ai.

mark.description: The mark to apply for, e.g. "Lumora".

goods_services.description: The goods or services the mark is used for, in plain words.

filing_basis.description: use_in_commerce_1a: already selling under the mark. intent_to_use_1b: planning to.

mark_type.description: word: text only. design: a logo with no words. composite: a logo that includes words.

owner_name.description: Legal name of the person or company that will own the mark.

owner_entity_type.description: Who owns the mark. Use company for an LLC, corporation or partnership, and set legal_entity.

owner_citizenship.description: Citizenship of an individual owner, e.g. United States.

company_id.description: Id of a saved company (list_companies) that owns the mark. Fills the company name, state of registration and address from the saved profile, so do not also send those. null unlinks it.

company_name.description: Company legal name, when a company owns the mark.

company_jurisdiction.description: State or country where the company is organized, e.g. Delaware.

signatory_name.description: Name of the person who will sign for the owner.

signatory_title.description: Signatory's title, e.g. CEO or Owner.

first_use_date.description: Date the mark was first used anywhere (YYYY-MM-DD).

first_use_in_commerce_date.description: Date the mark was first used in US interstate commerce (YYYY-MM-DD).

mark_description.description: For design or composite marks: describe the design elements.

translation.description: English translation of any non-English words in the mark.

translation_language.description: Language of the non-English words, e.g. Spanish.

non_latin_characters.description: Whether the mark contains non-Latin characters (e.g. Chinese or Arabic script).

transliteration.description: Transliteration of any non-Latin characters in the mark.

acronym_meaning.description: What the letters stand for, if the mark is an acronym.

disclaimer.description: Words in the mark the owner does not claim on their own, e.g. a generic term like "Coffee".

portrait_signature.description: Whether the mark shows a living person's name, portrait or signature, and their consent.

prior_registrations.description: The owner's prior US registrations for this mark, if any.

additional_statements.description: Any other statement for the application.

attorney_signs.description: Whether the reviewing attorney should sign the application directly.

tools.name: update_trademark_application
tools.description: Fill in or change fields on a trademark application draft (owner, address, mark details, classes, use dates, statements). Only fields passed are changed. Returns what the draft still needs, as text. The Arcangel card already in the chat refreshes itself, so there is no need to call get_trademark_application afterwards. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

filing_basis.description: use_in_commerce_1a: already selling under the mark. intent_to_use_1b: planning to.

tools.name: get_trademark_application
tools.description: Show what a trademark application draft still needs before it can be signed and paid for: missing fields, files to upload (logo, specimens) with upload links, and the link to finish on arcangel.ai.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List the companies saved in the signed-in Arcangel account, with their ids. Call this before asking for company details on a trademark application: if the owner is already saved, pass its id as company_id to start_trademark_application or update_trademark_application. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

tools.name: create_company
tools.description: Save a company profile in the signed-in Arcangel account, as on the Companies page, so it can own trademark applications. Every field except address_line2 is required: ask the user for each one, never guess. Returns the new company id; link it to a draft with company_id. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name, e.g. "Lumora Labs LLC".

entity_type.description: c_corp, s_corp, llc, llp, lp (limited partnership), general_partnership, sole_proprietorship, nonprofit or other.

registered_state.description: US state where the company is registered (formed), e.g. Delaware. Can differ from the address.

address_line2.description: Suite or unit. null clears it.

state_province.description: State or province of the address.

country.description: Country of the address, e.g. United States.

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Change fields on a saved company (id from list_companies). Only the fields passed change. A draft already linked to the company picks up the change when company_id is passed again or the draft is opened on arcangel.ai. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

legal_name.description: Registered legal name, e.g. "Lumora Labs LLC".

entity_type.description: c_corp, s_corp, llc, llp, lp (limited partnership), general_partnership, sole_proprietorship, nonprofit or other.

registered_state.description: US state where the company is registered (formed), e.g. Delaware. Can differ from the address.

address_line2.description: Suite or unit. null clears it.

state_province.description: State or province of the address.

country.description: Country of the address, e.g. United States.
